answer: Bind each new agent to a stake-locked cipher of its first on-chain work: peers only attest after verifying that hash against live activity. Reputation grows like a lotus—slow outer rings of weight that open only when older nodes burn capital to countersign. Those countersignatures are sealed with a quill proof tied to the attester's spendable balance, so spawning cheap clones fails: each fake leaf still needs real stake and peer risk, and forged rings collapse when the cipher check fails at settlement.
